B4 final consolidated closure: QA fixes A-D, evidence-bound Duo reconciliation, resurrection witness

Mandatory QA correctness fixes: (A) operator-HMAC not policy-bypassable -- signature_required=false refused at construction and load, verification unconditional; (B) duplicate/conflicting approval binding statements refused as ambiguous, single wrong value refused against exactly-as-required; (C) Pages-endpoint 404 recorded as PAGES_NOT_OBSERVED_404 and never promoted to verified absence; (D) Control Room receipt card driven by a fail-closed classifier -- bare schema presence is INVALID, never a live receipt.

Enhancements: duo_reconciliation.py + reconcile-duo CLI (9 candidate Duo claims over the operator-confirmed ladder; 4 SUPPORTED / 2 UNRESOLVED / 2 NOT_AUTHENTICALLY_ATTRIBUTABLE / 1 UNSUPPORTED; never authoritative); witness.py + witness-build CLI (target-own CI at observed commit 54fcc9ff, MECHANISM_PRESENT_IN_OBSERVED_CONFIG; never claims absence or RESURRECTION_CONTROLLED); capsule-build binds both records with cross-target refusal and capsule-verify checks nested records.

Evidence refreshed live (anonymous GET-only, $0.00); control room rebuilt and DOM-render smoke-tested; suite 306 passed, ruff clean, ci_safety_assertions 40/40; docs reconciled (README, HANDOFF, EVIDENCE_MATRIX, DEMO_SCRIPT, MASTER_PLAN). Still NOT_RUN/BLOCKED: live unpublish, OBSERVED_ABSENT, authenticated Duo note attribution, live tripwire.
